exercises.q: Tom took credit for my idea.
exercises.why: **приписал** — приписа́ть (perfective): to add (by writing); to attach, to register; to arrogate, to ascribe, to attribute, to impute. Wiktionary: при- + писа́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing)
correspondence (reciprocal exchange of letters, emails, etc.)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: запи́сывать — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); перепи́ска — correspondence (reciprocal exchange of letters, emails, etc.); вы́писка — writing out, copying; пи́саный — (colloquial) written down, fixed in writing.

exercises.q: Did you get a receipt from him?
exercises.why: **расписку** — распи́ска: receipt (written acknowledgement); promissory note. Wiktionary: расписа́ть + -ка.
